name: Keyboard Trainer
summary: A desktop-first typing game for children aged 6–12: ten keyboard challenges of increasing difficulty, with stars, XP and coins to earn on the way. Progress is stored only in the browser.
visualNote: Screens captured from the current development build, which runs under the working title KeyQuest. The result screen comes from a single automated sample session, not from player data.
